name: requirements-workshop
description: A structured, multi-turn requirements discussion, confirmed PRD, and PRD-first delivery workflow for Codex conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify and confirm requirements through a focused chat workflow.
interface.longDescription: Runs a focused multi-turn product or task discovery conversation. It maintains a concise decision record, creates a PRD from confirmed product or feature requirements, and uses that PRD as the primary source for downstream work.
defaultPrompt: Use Requirements Workshop to clarify this product idea.
Run a requirements discussion for this development task.
Confirm this feature scope and create a PRD.
